outline: This course focuses on developing students’ creative ideation, design thinking, and hands-on implementation skills through project-based learning. Students will be guided through a complete design process, including observation, problem exploration, concept development, prototyping, implementation, and iterative refinement. The course emphasizes the relationships among users, media, interaction, and context, and encourages students to explore different forms of creation using 2D and 3D media, digital media, and interactive technologies. Through iterative design, testing, and refinement, students will strengthen their abilities in concept communication, interdisciplinary integration, problem-solving, and project development.

flexible_learning.content:
Each group should complete a digital portfolio outlining the development process and final execution of their project this semester and submit it via the specified link.

The portfolio can be in the form of a video file or a presentation file (PPT, Canva link).
flexible_learning.outcome: Digital portfolio in the form of a video file or a presentation file (PPT, Canva link).
